propositions: The reconciler core currently calls Jira adapter methods directly with no named backend interface; a second backend cannot be implemented without duplicating call patterns

Five role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention) and three capability Protocols (SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsIncremental) must be defined in _backend.py with RemoteRef dataclass to establish a vendor-agnostic backend contract

JiraBackend must implement Backend as a thin delegation wrapper over existing Jira modules (acli, outbound_fields, inbound_fields, jira_fields, comment_limits) with zero behavior change to prove the port preserves current reconciler behavior

IdentityConvention must encapsulate the rebar-id:{remote_id} label format currently inlined at four core call sites (dispatch_one.py:320, binding_store.py:516, apply_inbound_records.py:223, binding_walk.py:341) as a new pure convention object under adapters/jira/identity.py
Capability-detection must use isinstance(backend, SupportsX) with @runtime_checkable Protocols and observed-via-behavior dispatch, not a capabilities() method or structural introspection

A backend-agnostic contract suite parameterized over backend_factory fixture must verify capability guarding, round-trip field mapping, sanitizer idempotence, and RemoteRef stamp/parse on both JiraBackend (with injected mock transport) and FakeBackend (test-only)
